tasks.label: Build
tasks.detail: Compila todo o projeto com javac (warnings habilitados)

args: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path build/classes -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; $sources = Get-ChildItem -Path src -Recurse -Filter '*.java' | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; javac --release 24 -Xlint:all -d build/classes $sources

tasks.label: Quality: Warnings Check
tasks.detail: Compila com -Xlint:all e -Werror — falha se houver qualquer warning

args: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path build/classes -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null; $sources = Get-ChildItem -Path src -Recurse -Filter '*.java' | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; javac --release 24 -Xlint:all -Werror -d build/classes $sources; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host '[FALHA] Existem warnings que precisam ser corrigidos!' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 } else { Write-Host ''; Write-Host '[OK] Nenhum warning encontrado.' -ForegroundColor Green }

mkdir -p build/classes && javac --release 24 -Xlint:all -Werror -d build/classes $(find src -name '*.java') && echo '' && echo '[OK] Nenhum warning encontrado.' || (echo '' && echo '[FALHA] Existem warnings que precisam ser corrigidos!' && exit 1)

tasks.label: Quality: i18n Check
tasks.detail: Valida traduções — falha se houver chaves faltando

args: javac tools/I18nValidator.java -d tools 2>&1; java -cp tools I18nValidator; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host '[FALHA] Inconsistências de i18n detectadas!' -ForegroundColor Red; exit $LASTEXITCODE } else { Write-Host '[OK] Traduções consistentes.' -ForegroundColor Green }
javac tools/I18nValidator.java -d tools && java -cp tools I18nValidator && echo '[OK] Traduções consistentes.' || (echo '[FALHA] Inconsistências de i18n detectadas!' && exit 1)
